findings.message: The new test only draws FormChips once, with a value already set (renderToStaticMarkup). It never takes the steps that the sentinel and the new `otherOn` state exist for: picking '+ new…' while the value is still empty, then typing one key at a time, including typing a name that matches a listed option while the text field is open. The fix moved 'is the text field open' from the value (the " " sentinel) into `useState`, and no test exercises that state change. The only case that checks the field opening is the single e2e case ('Northwind Traders'). Fix: add a test that drives the component: click '+ new…' with value '' and check the text field shows; type 'C','Co',…,'Contoso' and check the text field stays open and the Contoso chip is not checked; type 'Northwind ' and then 'Northwind T' key by key. Use the Playwright e2e for this, or add a DOM renderer to vitest; there is none in apps/web today.
findings.scenario: Swap the `otherOn` state for the value-derived check `other = !listed && value !== ""` (the sentinel-era rule without the " " sentinel). Clicking '+ new…' then sends onChange(''), so the text field disappears and the person can't type a new client. Typing 'Contoso' into the open field also closes it and checks the chip. All five cases in card-chips-106.test.ts still pass.

findings.message: A server-side lib (called by the 'use server' action checkCardField) now imports CHECK_FAILED from a client component folder (components/chat/form-values). This makes the server outcome mapping depend on the UI folder. Move CHECK_FAILED next to FieldCheck in @amax/chat (packages/chat/src/edits.ts) and import it from there on both sides.
Formatting slip: `generalOf =(form` is missing the space after `=`. The diff touched this line with no change to what it does. Restore `generalOf = (form`.
